capabilities: Size graph view nodes by aggregate outlink weight
Configure propagation depth, decay, scaling, and display range
Toggle outlink-based sizing with a command or hotkey
Optionally count repeated links and include attachment links
extras: Hooks Obsidian's internal graph renderer because there is no public API, so future Obsidian updates may break it; conflicts with other node-size plugins such as Extended Graph; developed against desktop only, mobile untested.
problem: Obsidian's graph view sizes nodes by how many links point to a note, so it cannot show which notes sit on top of the largest clusters through their outgoing links.
summary: Graph view plugin that sizes nodes by the combined size of the notes they link to, the inverse of Obsidian's backlink-based sizing.
